texts: Stroke in endocarditis most often comes from a vegetation on the mitral valve, the big swaying cards on the mitre sending a bowling ball up to the head lantern: D.
Mitral vegetations, above all large and mobile ones over about 10 mm, carry the highest embolic risk, and the brain is the commonest target.
Heart failure, the commonest complication, comes from valve destruction rather than coronary embolism; embolism is not more frequent in the elderly; and a pseudoaneurysm is prone to rupture.
Memory hook: the big swaying cards on the mitre throw the bowling ball at the head.
